title: artboardDocument
responsibility: Builds the sandbox document that puts a no-script, no-network policy before artboard HTML.

inputs.name: artboardDocument.html
inputs.description: Artboard HTML; a starter page is used when saving without it.

inputs.name: artboardDocument.theme
inputs.description: light, dark or both for rendering; light or dark for a viewer.

outputs.name: artboardDocument
outputs.description: Result: Builds the sandbox document that puts a no-script, no-network policy before artboard HTML.
